hypothesis: An explicit constant feature may explain the persistent fixed-work residual that remained within both allocation paths. Request-table occupancy may additionally explain variation during early allocations.

pcvs.name: fixed_work
pcvs.rationale: Provides an explicit basis for fixed bookkeeping and call overhead across internal execution paths.

pcvs.name: initial_allocation
pcvs.rationale: Separates initial allocation from the substantially cheaper decoding path.

pcvs.name: new_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Captures token-dependent work and distinguishes observed prompt sizes.

pcvs.name: active_request_tables
pcvs.rationale: Captures request-table occupancy, which can affect dictionary insertion and allocation bookkeeping.
